messages:
Maya: Quick sync — product needs a concise edge-case enumeration for the gen API GA checklist. Customers keep asking about streaming ambiguity, truncation semantics, token-limit behavior, and retries. I want a short acceptance criteria list + a prioritized scope (must-have vs nice-to-have). Thoughts?
Sam: I can draft a matrix. Key cases to cover: client mid-stream disconnect + resume, server preempt (evict KV/cache), prompt+response > max_tokens truncation path, deterministic retry/idempotency, partial stream when token-limit hit, retry with prefix-cache mismatch.
Alex: Also add ML-specifics: quantized models may early-stop differently; sampling vs beam differences on retry; temperature or seed drift causing different outputs after retry.
Priya: From SRE POV we need explicit SLO language and monitoring. Define p50/p95 latency, and fallback behavior. For truncation, we should specify "graceful truncation" vs hard cutoff. Standard error codes to emit: GENERATION_TRUNCATED, RETRY_EXCEEDED, STREAM_CANCELLED.
Chris: Customer story: large enterprise saw hallucination after a retry where the prompt was accidentally truncated by the client. They want a "replay-safe" guarantee or at least a clear flagging mechanism. Sales asked for this for an upcoming pilot.
Maya: Draft acceptance criteria proposal (short):
- Durable resume token for streaming that supports deterministic resume for same model+version combo.
- Emitted final event contains reason code and metadata when generation stops early (e.g., { code: "GENERATION_TRUNCATED", truncated_tokens: 12 }).
- Idempotent-retry contract: if client supplies request_id, retries should be either deduped or annotated so downstream can detect duplication.
- Default infra behavior: one automatic retry for transient infra failures; further retries need client control.
- Docs + canonical test harness with 10 minimal reproducible prompts for each edge class.
Sam: Implementation notes: resume token needs a small KV-snapshot id + token offset. Hard guarantee only possible when resume happens against the same model name+version+quantization. Cross-variant resume is a nice-to-have but complex. Also cost and memory implications (we'll need to retain small cache state for resume window).
Alex: I'll compile an edge-test list. Examples: repeated stop tokens, dynamic prefix mutation, long context near max_window, prompt that triggers early stop in quantized v.s. fp32, deterministic-seed reruns. Planning ~60 micro-cases across categories.
Priya: Launch gating suggestions:
- E2E CI with the canonical tests passing.
- Perf regression guard: p95 latency regression < 5% for typical workloads.
- Monitoring events emitted on all edge paths: gen.trace_id, gen.resume_token, gen.reason_code.
- Traces retained 30 days for debugging during initial pilot.
Sam: API shape note: we need product signoff on resume token format (opaque string vs structured JSON). Opaque is simpler, structured gives more debug signal. I can land engine changes in ~5 weeks if API is frozen this week.
Maya: Prioritization (my take):
- Must-have for GA: explicit reason codes, idempotent retry contract with request_id, minimal resume support (same model+version only), canonical tests + docs.
- Nice-to-have: cross-model resume, resume across quantization, optional resume without request_id, advanced heuristics for partial cache reconstruction.
Chris: Can we hit GA in 8 weeks for the sales pilot if we stick to must-haves? Sales expects yes if we cut the nice-to-have scope.
Sam: Realistic: engine + runtime work for must-haves is ~5 weeks, tests + docs + CI 2–3 weeks; so 7–8 weeks if we parallelize. Need product signoff on token format and error-code set this week.
Maya: @Sam please post a short token proto proposal in #eng-runtime and tag me. I'll update the PRD with these acceptance criteria and the must-have/nice-to-have split and share by EOD.
Alex: I'll upload the test matrix (subset) to the PRD draft and link sample inputs — will flag the non-deterministic cases that need heuristic handling.
Priya: I'll add required monitoring events and a Prometheus export mapping + example alert rules (e.g., >0.5% GENERATION_TRUNCATED in last 1h triggers incident).
Sam: quick example for final event shape suggestion:
```
final_event: {
  code: "GENERATION_TRUNCATED",
  truncated_tokens: 12,
  resume_token: "opaque_abc123",
  model: "redwood-13b@v2-q4"
}
```
Chris: Please ensure support has a short FAQ for pilot customers describing what to expect on retries and truncation. I'll draft the FAQ once PRD is updated.
deploy-bot: CI: gen-edge-tests pipeline passed (45/45) — build 2312 ✅
Maya: Thanks all — keeping this thread as canonical scoping. I'll post the updated PRD draft with acceptance criteria and a prioritized roadmap by EOD. :thumbsup:
